//: Known-failure (KF) probe catalog. Each case is enumerated by the issue it
covers - ids follow the tenant edge-case numbering (KF-<n>, letters when
one edge case has several failures). See README.md for the full KF table
and provenance.
Cases with an 'issue' assert the SPEC behavior and are deliberately RED
against a backend that still exhibits the 2026-07 observed behavior (no
xfail). 'observed' records that known behavior and is echoed in failure
messages so a known failure is distinguishable from new drift.
Cases with issue=null are green controls guarding correct behavior.
forbiddenResponseCodes is used where the tenant code table has no code
for the anomaly yet: the spec floor is 'must not validate clean (000)'.
e2e_enabled=false means the tenant ruled the edge case out of scope for
the API: the fixture and its spec stay committed for the record but the
case is not collected. Each disabled case records the decision and date
in its own comment block. See README.md 'Tenant triage'.
Control: the clean synthetic payslip scan that every blur probe derives
from. If this stops returning 000/Payslip, the environment itself has
regressed and the other probe results are not meaningful.
Control: mild real Gaussian blur (sigma 2.5), still readable. Spec: pass
(000) or trip the confidence gate (105) - which side of the tenant
threshold it lands on is legitimately the threshold's call, and it is
empirically nondeterministic near the boundary (sigma 3.5 returned 105
while sigma 3.6 returned 000 on the same day). 104 also acceptable now
that Textract blur detection exists.
Control: heavier Gaussian blur (sigma 3.5), degraded but classifiable.
Spec: 000/105 boundary call - see sigma2.5 note; 104 also acceptable.
Control: horizontal motion blur, 15px kernel (simulated camera shake),
degraded but classifiable. Spec: 000/105 boundary call, 104 acceptable.
Control: 200px thumbnail upscaled 8x - soft giant pixels, very low
effective DPI, but the content survives. Spec: 000 or 105. 104 added
2026-07-13: the newly-live Textract blur gate claims this capture (104,
jobStatus not_supported, jobId ed115ab5) - a legitimate boundary call
consistent with the sigma2.5/3.5/motion controls.
Control: two-page PDF, page 1 sharp payslip, page 2 the same payslip
Gaussian-blurred (sigma 4). Exercises the PDF ingestion path. A
multi-page PDF is a legitimate single document: spec and observed agree
on 000 (105 accepted since page 2 sits in the confidence boundary band).
KF-1a: extreme blur crashes the pipeline. Near-total Gaussian blur
(sigma 6): unreadable and unclassifiable. Spec: a graceful 104
BLURRY_DOCUMENT_DETECTED - never an HTTP 5xx (KF-1c).
